title: docs/adr: ADR-0090 D10 rule 4, ADR-0151 "Leaves unchanged" and the 2026-09-20 one-key note still describe ExecutionContext.performedBy as the OAuth client only; #33786 adds the in-product AI performer
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjrEpxMVxEiDUJHqC

Carrier card for the governed ADR text that card #33786 / PR #34018 makes inexact. The spec lane does not edit `docs/adr/**`. The contract review of PR #34018 escalated this as bookkeeping (round 1 record https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/34018#issuecomment-6897691839, ③; round 2 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/34018#issuecomment-6898426121).

**What #34018 does:** `ExecutionContext.performedBy` gains in-product AI keys (`agentId`, `conversationId`, `confirmationId`) beside `clientId`. The keys are stamped only by the server-constructed in-product AI path, after the server resolves each id for the person in `userId`. The hook face carries `performedByAgentId` and its siblings. The owner's ruling is on cloud#3826, as #33694 quotes it: "Accept AI-on-behalf, conversation id and confirmation id on the write context, using the existing `performed_by` / `on_behalf_of` columns plus contract fields. Do not add a new actor vocabulary". ADR-0011 :239 already records the cloud#3826 ruling chain for phase 1.

**Three passages in the tree now disagree with the spec:**
1. ADR-0090 D10 rule 4: a caller of any kind other than an agent principal "records the principal it authenticates as, and the missing `performed_by` is itself the record that the principal acted for itself".
2. ADR-0151, under "Leaves unchanged": "the meaning of `ExecutionContext.performedBy` (the OAuth client that acted for a person)".
3. ADR-0090's 2026-09-20 note calls `performedBy` a one-key object. It also refuses `traceId` / `requestId` as caller-controlled; #34018's resolve-before-stamp duty keeps that refusal whole.

**Ask:** use the add-only ADR note route to append a dated note to ADR-0090 (D10 rule 4 and the 2026-09-20 note) and to ADR-0151. The note should say that `performedBy` now has a second, server-constructed producer (the in-product AI path), which keys it carries, and the resolve-before-stamp rule. Cite the owner's ruling and ADR-0011 :239. Keep ADR-0151 D5's reasons intact: the subject stays the person, and `clientId` and `agentId` stay separate id namespaces. Do not name an audit column for the new keys; that mapping belongs to #33694.

Blocked-by: #33786 (PR #34018). Until it merges, the ADR text is still true of `main`.
